title: Vrindavan Nukkad Pathshala | Free Education for Hundreds of Underserved Children
description: Vrindavan Nukkad Pathshala is an initiative run by the Soul Of Braj Federation (SOBF). The Soul Of Braj Federation is a non-profit organization dedicated to serving the community in Vrindavan and the surrounding Braj region. ​Here's a breakdown of what Vrindavan Nukkad Pathshala is and its connection to the Soul Of Braj Federation: ​What is Vrindavan Nukkad Pathshala? It's a free after-school learning center for students, typically from KG to 10th grade. The name Vrindavan Nukkad Pathshala means street corner school, which reflects its aim to provide education at the doorstep of villages. The program focuses on improving foundational skills in subjects like Math, Science, and English.

title: Donate Blanket in Vrindavan | Donate Sweaters and Blankets in Vrindavan
description: Support the needy in Vrindavan by donating blankets and sweaters to help them stay warm during the winter. Your contribution brings comfort and care to those in need through the Brajkulam Community Center.

title: 100% Ban 🚫 on Alcohol and Drugs in Vrindavan | नशीले पदार्थों पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध | धार्मिक पवित्रता 🙌
description: This initiative aims to maintain the spiritual purity and sanctity of Vrindavan by promoting a complete ban on alcohol and drugs. It encourages a healthier, disciplined, and value-driven community aligned with the sacred essence of the Braj region

title: Donate Just 11₹ per month For Vrindavan Seva | 11₹ for Vrindavan Dham Seva
description: Join hands in serving Vrindavan by contributing just ₹11 per month. This small monthly support helps sustain seva activities such as food distribution, education, healthcare, and welfare programs for the needy in the Braj region.
